display_name: Super Thanks, Super Chat and Super Stickers
what_it_pays_for: One-off payments a viewer chooses to make - a tip on a video, or a highlighted message during a live stream. Unlike memberships there is no recurring commitment, and like memberships it unlocks at the lower Partner Program bar rather than the ad-revenue bar.

revenue_basis.note: A function of how many viewers tip and how much, minus the platform's share. Neither is published for any channel.

additional_requirements_not_assessed: No active Community Guidelines strikes on the channel
The channel is in a country or region where the programme operates
A linked and approved payments account
A minimum age applies to fan-funding products; the source read here does not state it

zh-CN.display_name: Super Thanks、Super Chat 与 Super Stickers
zh-CN.what_it_pays_for: 观众自愿给的一次性打赏——在视频下打赏，或在直播中花钱让自己的留言被高亮。和会员不同，它没有长期承诺；和会员相同的是，它也在较低那道门就能解锁，不必等到广告分成那一档。
additional_requirements_not_assessed: 频道没有生效中的社区准则警告。
该计划只在部分国家和地区开放，需要确认你的账号所在地在名单内。
需要绑定并通过审核的收款账户。
打赏类产品有最低年龄要求，本轮核对的页面没有写明具体数字。
zh-CN.no_figure_reason: 这一条没有公式可算：打赏是观众想给多少给多少、想什么时候给就什么时候给。它不像会员那样是「人数 × 单价」，所以连你自己的后台也只能告诉你已经收到了多少，算不出预期。

no_figure_reason: There is no formula to run here: a tip is whatever a viewer decides to give, whenever they decide to. Unlike memberships it is not a count times a price, so even your own dashboard shows only what has already come in, not what to expect.
